protocol: joint-limit-valid samples only; episode-key split; source-balanced fitting/evaluation; fixed seed
kinematic_scope: PCA reconstruction fingertip FK error in palm frame; joint limits are checked. Bank poses are observed training poses, converted to actual q entries.
collision_scope: Not evaluated. This offline feature/URDF analysis does not reproduce Isaac Lab's authored self-collision filters and PhysX contacts; collision validity requires a separate simulator witness.
limitations: pose coverage is geometry in joint space, not task or contact success
samples outside the authored joint limits are excluded before train/test splitting; source validity fractions are reported separately
source-balanced metrics use up to the configured number of samples per source
held-out unit is source trajectory key for the standard split and whole source for leave-one-source-out
K-means centers are converted to nearest observed pose before being called a bank entry
